websiteDocs.title: Sustain & Save Company Profile & Offerings
websiteDocs.content:
Sustain & Save partners with manufacturing plants, cold-chain facilities, commercial campuses, and healthcare labs across India to cut energy waste and meet ESG targets.
Core Products & Services:
1. EM-100 Industrial Energy Monitor: Real-time 3-phase power quality, kWh, and peak-demand telemetry unit with 24-month hardware warranty and automated threshold alerts.
2. Solar & Power-Quality Audits: On-site engineering assessment identifying harmonic distortion, capacitor bank tuning, and rooftop solar ROI. Typical industrial facilities achieve 12% to 18% electricity savings within 6 months.
3. Sustainable Packaging & Zero-Waste Advisory: Recyclable corrugated transit packaging conversion and material lifecycle audits.
4. Automated ESG & BRSR Reporting: Monthly Scope 2 tCO2e emission tracking and ISO 14001 audit-ready PDF exports.
Plans & Pricing (INR):
- Starter Energy Audit: ₹69,998/year (1 EM-100 unit, baseline audit, quarterly savings review).
- Growth Sustainability: ₹1,25,000/year (multi-meter telemetry, automated carbon dashboards, bi-monthly advisory).
- Enterprise Net-Zero: ₹2,40,000/year (plant-wide IoT metering, ISO 14001 / BRSR exports, dedicated account manager).

websiteDocs.title: Dual AI Chatbot Solution Quotation Summary (NMD/QT/2026/103)
websiteDocs.content:
AI Chatbot Platform Architecture (Quotation NMD/QT/2026/103 by NMD Pvt Ltd):
- Bot 1 (Website Frontend Bot): Public-facing 24x7 customer assistant trained strictly on approved company content, FAQs, policies, and website documents. Includes Smart Escalation to Call/WhatsApp when a question is outside training.
- Bot 2 (CRM Backend Bot): Internal employee assistant with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), read-only live CRM queries, Recharts pie/bar visual reports, and 100 initial training questions.
- Commercial Summary: Bot Development & Training ₹23,998 one-time (₹11,999 per bot); AI Usage / API Key ₹30,000/year (1M tokens per bot); Annual Maintenance (AMC) ₹16,000/year (₹8,000 per bot). First Year Total Payable: ₹69,998. Yearly Renewal from Year 2: ₹46,000.

crmDocs.title: CRM User Guide — Lead Management & Pipeline Stages
crmDocs.content:
Lead Management Module User Guide:
1. Accessing Leads: Navigate to CRM Workspace > Data Explorer > Leads tab. Records are read-only inside the AI Copilot.
2. Pipeline Stages: New -> Qualified -> Proposal Sent -> Negotiation -> Won / Lost.
3. Qualification Rules: Confirm facility energy load, sustainability scope (EM-100, Solar Audit, Net-Zero), decision-maker contact, and target implementation timeline before moving a lead to Qualified.
4. Response SLA: Inbound Website Chatbot leads must receive outreach within 4 business hours.
5. Role Scope: CRM Employees view leads assigned to their owner name; CRM Admins and Super Admins view organization-wide pipeline metrics.

crmDocs.title: Internal SOP — Customer Follow-Ups & Support Ticket Escalations
crmDocs.content:
Follow-Up & Ticket Handling SOP:
- Daily Follow-Up Cadence: Clear Overdue follow-ups before 11:00 AM IST each day. High-priority follow-ups must never breach 24 hours overdue.
- Escalation Rule: After 3 unanswered outreach attempts or when a client requests custom commercial terms (>10% discount), escalate to CRM Admin.
- Ticket SLAs: High priority (Hardware Telemetry outage) = 2h response / 4h triage; Medium priority (ESG Reporting / Billing) = 12h; Low priority (Portal Access) = 24h.
- Read-Only AI Policy: Bot 2 cannot edit, close, or delete CRM leads, customers, follow-ups, or tickets. All state changes must be performed in the primary CRM system.

trainingQuestions.answer: The 6 approved stages are: New -> Qualified -> Proposal Sent -> Negotiation -> Won / Lost.

trainingQuestions.question: When should a lead be marked Qualified?

trainingQuestions.question: How quickly must Website Chatbot leads be contacted?

trainingQuestions.question: Can CRM Employees view leads owned by other reps?

trainingQuestions.question: Can the CRM AI Chatbot delete duplicate leads?

trainingQuestions.question: What fields are mandatory before moving a lead to Proposal Sent?

trainingQuestions.question: How is estimated lead value calculated?

trainingQuestions.question: What happens when a lead is marked Lost?

trainingQuestions.question: How do I export a lead report for leadership?

trainingQuestions.question: What roles exist in the Sustain & Save platform?
trainingQuestions.answer: Four roles: SUPER_ADMIN (full platform control), CRM_ADMIN (CRM bot, training, reports), CRM_EMPLOYEE (CRM chat & scoped read-only data), and WEBSITE_VISITOR (public bot only).

trainingQuestions.question: Can a user assign themselves CRM_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN?
trainingQuestions.answer: No. Firestore Security Rules strictly block self-assignment of privileged roles. Only a Super Admin can promote users.

trainingQuestions.question: How is CRM data protected from public website visitors?
trainingQuestions.answer: All CRM API endpoints require a verified Firebase ID token and server-side RBAC check, and Website Bot has zero access to CRM data or CRM knowledge.

trainingQuestions.question: Why does the CRM bot refuse delete or update commands?
trainingQuestions.answer: By design and security policy, Bot 2 uses read-only data access so AI prompts can never corrupt or erase production CRM records.

trainingQuestions.question: Does the AI ever invent CRM numbers or chart figures?
trainingQuestions.answer: Never. All counts, INR sums, percentages, and Recharts series are computed deterministically from the CRM data provider before Gemini summarizes them.

trainingQuestions.question: How does RAG work for CRM documents?
trainingQuestions.answer: Uploaded PDF, DOCX, and TXT files are extracted, split into overlapping chunks, embedded with Gemini Embedding 2, and retrieved by similarity before generating answers.

trainingQuestions.question: Do Website Bot and CRM Bot share the same knowledge base?
trainingQuestions.answer: No. Website Bot uses /website_knowledge_base and CRM Bot uses /crm_knowledge_base. Their indexes never mix.

trainingQuestions.question: How do administrators add new training questions?

trainingQuestions.question: Does the chatbot automatically learn from unverified user chats?

trainingQuestions.question: What happens when the CRM bot does not know an answer?

trainingQuestions.question: Where are all chatbot conversations archived?
trainingQuestions.answer: Website conversations are stored in /website_conversations and CRM conversations in /crm_conversations with message subcollections and timestamps.

trainingQuestions.question: Can admins review unanswered questions?
trainingQuestions.answer: Yes, the Escalation Management and Chat History views highlight unanswered and escalated threads for review.

trainingQuestions.question: What AI model powers both chatbots?
trainingQuestions.answer: Both bots run on Google Gemini Flash (gemini-4-hydrogen) via secure server-side API calls, with configurable temperature and length.

trainingQuestions.question: Are Gemini API keys stored in the browser?
trainingQuestions.answer: Never. All @google/genai calls execute strictly on the Express backend using process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY.

trainingQuestions.question: What is included in the Annual Maintenance (AMC)?

messages.text: What is Scope 2 carbon reporting and why does it matter?

Scope 2 carbon emissions refer to the indirect greenhouse gas emissions associated with the purchase of electricity, steam, heating, or cooling consumed by an organization. Essentially, while you aren't burning the fuel yourself, you are responsible for the emissions generated by the power plants that produce the energy you use.

Tracking Scope 2 emissions is critical for several reasons:

1. **ESG & Regulatory Compliance:** Many industries are now required to provide BRSR (Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting) and comply with ISO 14001 standards. 
2. **Operational Efficiency:** Understanding your consumption patterns helps identify energy waste, leading to direct cost savings.
3. **Corporate Responsibility:** Accurate reporting demonstrates your commitment to sustainability to stakeholders and customers.

At Sustain & Save, we automate this process with our Enterprise Net-Zero plan, which provides plant-wide IoT metering and audit-ready PDF exports to simplify your compliance reporting.

3. **Infrastructure Strategy:** Transitioning to optimized hardware and monitoring allows for better load management in high-consumption environments like cold chains.

We offer plans ranging from a **Starter Energy Audit** (₹69,998/year) to **Enterprise Net-Zero** solutions. Would you like to speak with our team to discuss an audit?
